notes.title: The release of the game!
notes.notes:
Our game comes out of early access.
Changes:
-Updated the environment at the level of
- Unlocked all skins (temporarily) in the future when we add the system 
inventory, skins will be available only those that you have in your inventory
-For correct display in the leaderboard, your nickname must be in English
- Reset leaderboard
- Added a new language and now in game their 2: Russian and English
- Changed timer system
- Fixed bug with getting achievements
- Added a separate scene to get achievements
(if you have entered the achievement scene and the counter is not moving, go to the main menu and go to the achievements again)
- Fixed minor bugs
-To get the thing you want to be in the game 15 minutes(if you have not received a thing, then reconnect to the game)

notes.title: Global update of the game!!!
notes.notes:
ADDED ITEM DROP SYSTEM FOR TIME SPENT IN THE GAME!
Now you can get a random thing just by playing the game.
So far, these things can not be used in the game, but in the future we will implement it.
Added 4 skins.
To get the thing you need to stay in the game 30 minutes.
The maximum per day, you can knock out 2 things.
Things can be sold on the trading floor.
If you stayed in the game for 30 minutes and did not get the thing, then go to the game and in the first minutes you will get your item.
Definitely when you got a thing, you reconnect to the game, otherwise you will not fall a second thing.
More things will be added in the future.
You can suggest what things or skin to add in discussions.
Enjoy the game.
